title: Suzanne R NDE 21308
content: As a child, I had an accident at the club while running around the locker room. I bumped my head against the edge of a locker and passed out. I came to once as my sisters were dragging me out into the reception area. I remember the clerk starting to yell at me and then everything went black. The next thing I remember was the feeling that I was on the outside of my family car, looking in. I could see the road we were traveling and I looked into the car. I could see myself in the car, with my head slumped against the window. I remember that my hair was crushed up against the window and I could see that from the outside. I never told anyone as a child because I didn't think it really happened. Years later, I heard of out of body experiences and realized that this is what had happened. I still have the lump on the back of my head!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident 'Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening'.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Physically I was unconscious but my spiritual side was very alert.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain I don't know. I could see clearly although it was night and I could make out fine details.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I realized that there is a wider metaphysical world that cannot be ignored.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Didn't think anyone would believe me. I thought that it was a dream and didn't know why I had such a vivid memory and picture in my head.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I was too young to know my capabilities.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The worst is that it was very painful. I had a concussion. The best part was later in life when I realized that it did happen.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I don't know what they thought.
